title: chrysanthemum nanum
intro: Chrysanthemum nanum, commonly known as the Korean chrysanthemum or Korean gold, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum nanum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum nanum include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
